## Tavus API removed ✅

Executed the full removal plan across all 6 phases on branch `greyboard/ISSUE-2-remove-tavus-api`. **48 files changed, +21 / −2313**, sliced into 5 commits (`06f94691` → `378d72c5`).

### What changed
- **Phase 1 — deleted whole units:** `packages/tavus`, `apps/mirror/app/api/tavus`, `apps/mirror/features/video-call`, `apps/mirror/e2e/video-call.spec.ts`, and the `tavus-cvi-*` skills under both `.claude/skills` and `.agents/skills`.
- **Phase 2 — unwired the profile "Video" button:** threaded `onOpenVideoCall` out of @apps/mirror/features/profile/components/editable-profile-actions.tsx (now a single "Text" action), @apps/mirror/features/profile/components/profile-info.tsx, @apps/mirror/app/[username]/_components/profile-panel.tsx, and @apps/mirror/app/[username]/_providers/profile-route-data-context.tsx (dropped the `dynamic()` VideoCallModal import, `videoCallOpen` state/type/render block). Fixed the mock in @apps/mirror/app/[username]/_providers/__tests__/clone-actions-context.test.tsx.
- **Phase 3 — env & build config:** deleted `lib/env/server.ts` (it validated only `TAVUS_*`), pruned the CSP in @apps/mirror/next.config.ts (removed `*.daily.co` + `tavusapi.com`, **kept** Convex cover-video `media-src` per PLAN_010, tightened `Permissions-Policy` camera/mic → `()`), and removed the deps/env from @apps/mirror/package.json, @turbo.json, and `.env.local.example`. Lockfile regenerated (0 tavus/daily refs).
- **Phase 4 — Convex dead code:** removed `getByUsernameForConversation` + `conversationArticleReturnValidator` from @packages/convex/convex/articles/queries.ts / @packages/convex/convex/articles/helpers.ts and its test block.
- **Phases 5–6 — scripts & docs:** purged Tavus from @scripts/restore-env-local.sh, `sync-worktree-convex-env.sh`, @apps/mirror/AGENTS.md, the `worktrees.md` rules, and the `create-codebase-expert` / `create-skill` skills (`.claude` + `.agents` kept in lockstep).

### Verification
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm install` | ✅ lockfile clean, 0 `@feel-good/tavus` / `@daily-co/*` |
| `pnpm build --filter=@feel-good/mirror` | ✅ compiles & type-checks; no `/api/tavus` route, `exhaust-chat-daily` (daily rate-limit) correctly retained |
| `pnpm lint --filter=@feel-good/mirror` | ✅ 0 errors (2 pre-existing warnings) |
| `pnpm --filter=@feel-good/mirror test:unit` | ✅ 349/349 pass |
| Convex `articles/queries.test.ts` | ✅ 2/2 pass |
| Final `grep -ril tavus` | ✅ only the intentionally-retained historical tickets |

### Heads-up / not run here
- **Convex `verify:codegen` (live) couldn't run** — this worktree has no provisioned Convex dev deployment (`CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT` unset), and the gate pushes to a deployment. I verified instead that `_generated/` has **no** stale `getByUsernameForConversation` reference and is git-clean (the API references modules whole, so removing a function within one produces no codegen diff). Worth a quick `verify:codegen` run from a provisioned worktree before merge.
- **Chrome visual check not done** — needs a provisioned backend + signed-in profile to render. The build confirms the profile route compiles with the Video action gone; a human should eyeball a profile to confirm the single "Text" action lays out well.
- **2 pre-existing Convex test failures** (`chat/rateLimits.test.ts`, `embeddings/bio-source.test.ts` — a "project" serializer registry drift from the Projects tab #101). I confirmed both fail identically on the pristine tree via `git stash`, so they're **unrelated** to this task.
- **History left untouched** per the plan's Decisions: canceled/completed tickets (FG_012/046/048/170) and the cover-video plan / FG_197 still mention Tavus/Daily as archival record — none contain live code.

Not opening a PR — review & merge stay yours.

payload.subtaskTitle: Update stale health.md docs after video-call removal from AGENTS.md

payload.summary: Reviewed the full main...HEAD diff (48 files, +21/-2313 lines) removing the Tavus CVI video-calling integration and its Daily.co dependency, dispatching the review-code skill's full reviewer fleet (correctness, convention, tests, maintainability, agent-native, security, data-integrity) alongside manual verification of dangling references, lockfile/workspace consistency, CSP/Permissions-Policy correctness, Convex codegen freshness, and directory deletions. The removal is thorough and self-consistent: no dangling imports, props, env vars, or Convex query/validator references anywhere in the tree; the previously-flagged unauthenticated-Tavus-route security concern (canceled ticket FG_012) is now moot since the route is deleted entirely; CSP/Permissions-Policy correctly drop camera/microphone/Daily.co/tavusapi.com while retaining what surviving features (e.g. Convex-hosted cover video) still need; and all associated tests were updated or removed consistently with passing suites. The single surviving finding is a P3/nit: `.claude/health.md` and `.agents/health.md` still describe `apps/mirror/AGENTS.md` as "Current" while citing "video-call features added," which this same PR just removed from AGENTS.md — filed as ISSUE-7. Harness-reported `bun run typecheck` failure is a pre-existing repo gap (no `typecheck` script exists anywhere in the monorepo, on main or this branch) unrelated to this diff.

entries.body: Fixed the last open finding (ISSUE-7): updated the stale "video-call features added" note in both @.claude/health.md and @.agents/health.md to "Onboarding features added", matching the actual AGENTS.md (mirror) content after the Tavus removal. Docs-only change, no build/lint tier applies — diff verified by re-reading both files.
